rows.title: Attempt on Hexagonal self-avoiding-walk scaling limit
rows.body:
ATTEMPT RECORD from the Codex campaign (author-checked by that worker only). Method: Exact finite-domain conditional law Result: For a finite-graph a-to-b self-avoiding path with weight z^length, condition on an initial simple prefix. The remaining path has the same fugacity law on the graph with earlier prefix vertices removed. The factor z^prefix_length cancels between numerator and partition function. Check: The endpoint stays in the graph; deleting it would invalidate the argument. Fixed-length conditioning also fixes the remaining length and is a different ensemble. Obstruction: This domain Markov property supplies neither tightness nor conformal invariance and does not identify an SLE scaling limit.
